title: Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas: Correcting a Swing Shortfall Line
content:
**1.** A swing shortfall correction on a Commercial Natural Gas Supply agreement is worked on the agreement's most recently posted swing shortfall charge line. The over-billed amount on that shortfall line is returned as one rebill credit, tied to the line through its source bill line reference and dated on the correction date.

**2.** A business that asks for the shortfall line to be put right once it has been pointed out to it is disputing that line.

**3.** This shortfall correction covers an agreement whose plan has no portfolio bandwidth, or an agreement that is the business's only commercial gas agreement on a plan with portfolio bandwidth. Where the business has two or more agreements on plans with portfolio bandwidth, the portfolio measure decides the swing and the shortfall line is outside this correction.

## Tool: `post_bizgas_shortfall_rebill_b4d87cc1`

*Capability.* `post_bizgas_shortfall_rebill_b4d87cc1` posts a rebill credit that returns money over-billed on one Commercial Natural Gas Supply swing shortfall bill line. One call adds one rebill credit line to the commercial gas agreement's billing ledger, tied to the corrected swing shortfall line, dated today and carried as a negative amount, so the business sees the credit against that line on its next utility bill and the agreement's net billed charges fall by the credited amount. The credit is booked exactly as given.

*Invocation.* An agent-side tool: the care agent unlocks `post_bizgas_shortfall_rebill_b4d87cc1` with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and then calls it through `call_agent_discoverable_tool` with the four parameters below.

*Parameters.*

- `bizgas_agreement_id` — the commercial gas agreement number of the site whose swing shortfall line is corrected, as shown on the agreement record returned by the commercial gas agreement lookup. Identifier, text.
- `source_billing_id` — the reference number of the swing shortfall bill line being corrected, as shown on that line in the commercial gas bill line lookup. Identifier, text.
- `billing_period_start` — the first day of the billing cycle of the corrected line, written YYYY-MM-DD exactly as it appears on that line; no time zone.
- `rebill_amount_usd` — the amount being returned on the line, given as a positive number of US dollars rounded half up to 2 decimal places; it is booked on the ledger in US dollars to 2 decimal places, signed, as a negative credit.

*Return.* A text rendering of a dictionary with `status` (the literal "posted" when the credit was booked), `bizgas_billing_id` (the reference number of the new rebill credit line), `source_billing_id` (the corrected line's reference number), `amount_usd` (the signed credit booked, negative, 2 decimal places) and `posted_date` (today's date, YYYY-MM-DD).

## Scope questions

**A business holds one agreement on a plan without portfolio bandwidth and another on a plan with it. Is the shortfall line of either within this correction?** Yes for both: the first because its plan has no portfolio bandwidth, the second because it is the business's only agreement on a plan with portfolio bandwidth.

**A business holds three agreements on plans with portfolio bandwidth.** The shortfall lines of those three agreements are outside this correction; the portfolio measure decides their swing.

**What does the booked credit look like?** A hypothetical `rebill_amount_usd` of 12.75 is returned with an `amount_usd` of -12.75.
